description: Compute joint statistics. Various density measures of fractures, filtered by range, can be computed. Live 9.7 continuation slot also offers DFN-style fracture statistics (average-trace-length, p10/p20/p21/p30/p32/p33) alongside the documented center-density/mass-density/percolation/trace-* measures.

keywords.name: average-trace-length
keywords.description: Return the average trace length (trace length divided by number of traces), where traces are the intersections between the fractures and the input planar geometry set. Options: geometry <s>: Average trace length is measured over the area of a planar geometry set with name s .

keywords.name: center-density
keywords.description: Synonym for kwd: \(P30\) .

keywords.name: mass-density
keywords.description: Synonym for kwd: \(P32\) .

keywords.name: p10
keywords.description: Return the P10 (number of fracture per unit length of measurement) along the line defined by begin and end , or along the geometry edges defined with the geometry keyword. Options: geometry <s>: P10 is measured along the edges of the geometry set with name s . Cannot be given with the begin or end keywords.; begin <v>: Define the starting point of the reference line where P10 is measured. Cannot be given with the geometry keyword.; end <v>: Define the ending point of the reference line where P10 is measured. Cannot be given with the geometry keyword.

keywords.name: p20
keywords.description: Return the P20 (number of fracture per unit area of measurement) on the geometry defined with the geometry keyword. Options: geometry <s>: P20 is measured over the area of a planar geometry set with name s .

keywords.name: p21
keywords.description: Return the P21 (length of fracture per unit area of measurement) on the geometry defined with the geometry keyword. Options: geometry <s>: P20 is measured over the area of a planar geometry set with name s .

keywords.name: p30
keywords.description: Return the P30 (number of fracture per unit volume of measurement) inside the specified box. Options: box <fx1><fx2><fy1><fy2><fz1><fz2>: P30 is measured over the volume of the box.

keywords.name: p32
keywords.description: Return the P32 (area of fracture per unit volume of measurement) inside the specified box. Options: box <fx1><fx2><fy1><fy2><fz1><fz2>: P32 is measured over the volume of the box.

keywords.name: p33
keywords.description: Return the P33 (volume of fracture per unit volume of measurement) inside the specified box. Options: box <fx1><fx2><fy1><fy2><fz1><fz2>: P33 is measured over the volume of the box.

keywords.description: Synonym for kwd: \(P20\) .

keywords.description: Synonym for kwd: \(P21\) .

keywords.name: percolation
keywords.description: Synonym for P33 .
